head: 0f52743a83e5e5441a922a1ce6032da797cf866b
summary: Framework-free Payment aggregate; the transition table lives only in PaymentStatus.next() and matches ADR 0011. Tests cover each allowed move, all 24 illegal pairs (checked against an independent table), value-object validation and nulls. Money is long plus Currency. No blockers or majors.

acceptance_criteria.evidence: PaymentTest#illegalTransitionIsRejected (24 pairs, asserts state unchanged), statusTableMatchesAdr0011, and one named test per allowed transition.
PaymentTest named transition tests plus parameterised illegal pairs incl. all terminal-state moves and self-moves; IllegalPaymentTransitionException message names both states.

findings.description: Money accepts non-positive amounts and positivity is enforced only in Payment; fine for now, but a later reuse for non-payment values must not assume positivity.
findings.suggestion: Optional: note in Javadoc that positivity is the Payment's invariant.
